turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always nice when you can coordinate kitchen time with Sam. How is he doing lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's good! Busy with his own work, but we caught up a bit yesterday. I'm hoping to get some rock climbing in later this week to decompress.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great way to wind down after a busy Monday. Well, I hope your presentation goes amazingly well. Let me know how it goes!

turns.speaker: user
